```yaml
name: Test Rust bpftrace tutorials

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test-bpftrace:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          override: true
          profile: minimal

      - name: Install bpftrace
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y bpftrace

      - name: Build helloworld (debug)
        run: |
          cd rust/helloworld
          cargo build --verbose

      - name: Verify hello symbol in helloworld
        run: |
          cd rust/helloworld
          objdump -t target/debug/helloworld | grep -E '_ZN10helloworld5hello' || (echo "Symbol _ZN10helloworld5hello not found" && exit 1)

      - name: Build args (debug)
        run: |
          cd rust/args
          cargo build --verbose

      - name: Verify hello symbol in args
        run: |
          cd rust/args
          objdump -t target/debug/args | grep -E '_ZN10helloworld5hello' || (echo "Symbol _ZN10helloworld5hello not found" && exit 1)

      - name: Run args binary
        run: |
          cd rust/args
          ./target/debug/args

      - name: Test bpftrace attach to args
        run: |
          cd rust/args
          BINARY=$(pwd)/target/debug/args
          # Start bpftrace in background, redirect output to a file
          bpftrace -e "uprobe:${BINARY}:_ZN10helloworld5hello* { printf(\"hello called\\n\"); }" > /tmp/bpftrace_output 2>&1 &
          BPFTRACE_PID=$!
          # Give bpftrace a moment to attach
          sleep 1
          # Run the binary again to trigger the trace
          ./target/debug/args
          # Allow bpftrace to process the event
          sleep 1
          # Stop bpftrace
          kill $BPFTRACE_PID
          wait $BPFTRACE_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          # Verify that the trace output contains the expected string
          if grep -q "hello called" /tmp/bpftrace_output; then
            echo "bpftrace successfully traced hello function"
          else
            echo "bpftrace did not trace hello function"
            exit 1
          fi
```
